en.title: Wisdom tooth removal: the risk to your nerve

chips.risk: About 7 in 100 get some nerve damage

sentences.text: This is a stuck (impacted) lower wisdom tooth.
sentences.tts: This is a stuck, impacted, lower wisdom tooth.

sentences.text: Its roots wrap around a nerve.
Taking it out can damage the nerve and make your lip and chin numb.
The red part is the nerve.
It gives feeling to the lower teeth, gums, lip and chin.
As the tooth comes out, the nerve can be pressed or cut.
For a tooth like this, rates vary, but about 7 in 100 may get nerve damage.
Most get better within a few months.
About 1 in 100 may have damage that does not go away, and for most of them it is mild.
So it is a good idea to see a specialist (an oral surgeon) first.
sentences.tts: So it is a good idea to see a specialist, an oral surgeon, first.
